findings.text: follow-on: the head arm's gate log header records repo_revision=7a50473b (the base sha) while the arm measured head content and passed the collapse test it lacks at base, and the manifest's after_suite declares revision ebadacae3, so the read-time head_log_revision reads this arm as having run at the base commit and a reader cannot tie the zero added failures to the reviewed head without opening the log.

follow-on: the baseline_suite and after_suite `command` fields record `python -m pytest -p no:cacheprovider --timeout=300 -q <files>` while the logs' own command lines record `-n 4` and the absolute interpreter, so the stored suite records name a command that did not run and the reviewed gate cannot be reproduced from the record alone.
